summary: Plain residential kerb with houses 11-15 m behind; a few cars park here.

drivers.seclusion: Houses with front gardens 12-23 m behind the kerb on the same side; no bush or open land.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide street; cars park at the kerb, so room to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moderate local traffic, close to a junction at the south end.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along the kerb, but no campervan convention.

flags: Slope up to 9.3% over one step, 2.5% mean
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the east in the morning; open to the west in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Usher Street east kerb, under the street trees before the junction
